# Citation export dependencies

Used by Org CSL export in local and GitHub builds.

- citeproc: git@github.com:andras-simonyi/citeproc-el.git, commit `a3d62ab8e40a75fcfc6e4c0c107e3137b4db6db8`.
- dash: git@github.com:magnars/dash.el.git, commit `fb443e7a6e660ba849cafcd01021d9aac3ac6764`.
- s: git@github.com:magnars/s.el.git, commit `dda84d38fffdaf0c9b12837b504b402af910d01d`.
- f: git@github.com:rejeep/f.el.git, commit `931b6d0667fe03e7bf1c6c282d6d8d7006143c52`.
- queue: git@github.com:emacs-straight/queue.git, commit `8df1334d54d4735d2f821790422a850dfaaa08ef`.
- string-inflection: git@github.com:akicho8/string-inflection.git, commit `4a2f87d7b47f5efe702a78f8a40a98df36eeba13`.
- parsebib: git@github.com:joostkremers/parsebib.git, commit `5b837e0a5b91a69cc0e5086d8e4a71d6d86dac93`.
- compat: git@github.com:emacs-compat/compat.git, commit `cf142601916763ca6203c953b28055dce8cfd2e5`.
